name: hud_teammate_tower_greys_sell
description: A teammate's tower is theirs (design 5.7): selected, it names its owner ("Seat 2's"), the card shows my own kit on Q W E rather than its branches, Sell greys and its tooltip says whose the tower is, and S orders nothing but says "That tower is Seat 2's". My own tower beside it offers its branches and sells, at Thrifty's 90%.

steps.msg: the partner, a Lookout, stands a Perch Ballista

steps.assert: card[4].what == 'sell' and card[4].state == 'idle' and node('Sell').disabled and card[4].cost == ''
steps.msg: Sell greys: the tower is the partner's

steps.assert: [card[0].what, card[1].what, card[2].what] == ['arrow', 'cannon', 'frost'] and not card[0].hammer and not card[1].hammer
steps.msg: the card shows my own kit, not the tower's branches: only its builder forks it

steps.assert: node('Minimap').tower_color(2, Game.seat_count()) == Color('#56B4E9') and node('Minimap').tower_color(1, Game.seat_count()) == Color('#E69F00') and node('Minimap').tower_color(2, 1) == Color('#9cc4ff')
steps.msg: on the minimap each tower is marked in its owner's seat colour while several seats play

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and screen_has("That tower is Seat 2's: only its builder sells it.")
steps.msg: Sell's tooltip says whose it is

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == "That tower is Seat 2's" and scene.settled() and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(10, 7)) != null
steps.msg: S on it orders nothing and says whose it is

steps.assert: card[0].what == 'longbow_loft' and card[1].what == 'skyward_loft' and card[4].state == 'ok' and card[4].cost == '+36'
steps.msg: my own tower offers its branches, and sells for 90% of its 40 (Thrifty)
